title: Transfermarkt - Wikipedia
content: # Transfermarkt. | URL | * transfermarkt.de (in German) * transfermarkt.com (in English) |. **Transfermarkt** is a German-based website owned by Axel Springer SE that has footballing information, such as scores, results, statistics, transfer news, and fixtures. According to the IVW, it is in the top 25 most visited German websites, and one of the largest sport websites after kicker.de. The website has scores, results, transfer news, fixtures, and player values. The website was founded in May 2000, by Matthias Seidel to track players and transfer targets for SV Werder Bremen before expanding to other teams. In 2008, Axel Springer publishing house acquired a 51% share in the website. In 2010, IVW ranked it among the 25 most visited German websites, and one of the biggest sports sites after Kicker "Kicker (magazine)"). As a result, Transfermarkt.de publicly apologized for the incidents and issues that were caused during the relaunch.
